Your Google account is not connected. I checked without connecting it.

- **Configured:** No. The Google provider isn't set up locally.
- **Tokens:** None stored.
- **ghealth CLI credentials:** Not found.
- **Active jobs:** None.

The Google Health API itself is reachable. Google isn't onboarding new projects, so setup relies on the existing ghealth CLI project. If you want to connect later, the usual route is `ghealth auth login`, after which the server picks up the credentials. While the consent screen is in Testing mode, the refresh token expires after 7 days, so you'd need to log in again periodically.

If API access doesn't work out, you can also import a Google Takeout export instead.
